nativeMatrix.purpose: Multi-digit suffixes/preset collision/literal final suffix/long names in every font-locale-viewport cell. Existing ordinal203 exactly matches the conflicted draft: Save as a separate scale must allocate a fresh instance even though normal import would reuse203.

measurement.scope: FROZEN VALID LEGACY RAW INPUTS ONLY. Every measured record has an ASCII name of at most40 characters and uses accepted public notes. Unicode occurs only in preserved unknown record-level measurementMetadata. Complete envelope stress/field names are separate; these are not predicted envelope sizes or passing performance results.

recordRecipe.seed: i=0 inventories.large103.seed; i=1 inventories.pygmyInner18.seed; otherwise inventories.amara9.seed
recordRecipe.nameSuffix: i+1 as exactly four decimal digits
recordRecipe.mirror: true for odd i, false for even i
recordRecipe.anchor: between for odd i, one for even i

legacy1MiB.baseRecipe: recordRecipe at i=0 including record-level measurementMetadata; append record-level measurementPadding after measurementMetadata
legacy1MiB.retention: measurementPadding is an unknown record4 field; preserve it plus the exact raw migration source

measurement.acceptance: measure old source plus immutable raw snapshot plus transformed envelope peak independently. Report actual acknowledged write/quota refusal without deleting recovery sources or raising performance gates.

uiContract.behavior: Status is visibly persistent in session/recovery mode. Conflict keeps the dirty draft until explicit Save as a separate scale or Back/Escape cancellation. Back discards that draft and returns to the acknowledged winner, canonical content URL and opener focus. No additional Review button/workflow is required.

en.session: Changes in this tab are temporary. They disappear when you reload or close this tab.
en.recovery: Saved scales could not be read. Your saved scales have not been changed. Temporary changes in this tab disappear when you reload or close it.
en.conflict: This scale changed in another tab. Your draft is still here. Save it as a separate scale or go back to the saved version.
en.conflictDeleted: This scale was removed in another tab. Your draft is still here. Save it as a separate scale or go back.
en.resetConflict: Seeded scales changed in another tab. Nothing was reset. Review them before tapping RESET SEEDED SCALES again.
